answer: Diversity Threshold: full rewards require 12 deals with unrelated counterparties in 20 epochs. A newcomer's kernel starts empty; each deal adds one link, and the graph flags star clusters. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must fabricate 12,000 links at 5 units each, 60,000 units, while fake-to-fake trades pay zero once exposed. An honest agent pays once. Its record rises like a knoll above flat ground. At the zenith, its rewards arrive undiluted.
